metadata.description: Personal, portable toolkit of reusable Claude systems: skills, rules, hooks, and templates shared across every project and device.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Two skills: project-init walks you through setting up a new project (scaffolding, hooks, memory system, knowledge layer, CLAUDE.md) one skippable gate at a time; project-sync audits an existing project against the toolkit and closes the gaps you approve.

plugins.name: sf-architect-solutioning
plugins.description: Salesforce solution architect skill: pushes back on vague requirements, verifies platform facts against official Salesforce docs (live fetch, never memory), designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces an approved solution plan before any build.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Portable second-brain memory and knowledge architecture (MCP): a shared Cloudflare Worker MCP server backed by a per-project Neon Postgres/pgvector database and GitHub OAuth, holding a typed-node knowledge graph curated by two background agents, with hybrid keyword+vector recall, an auto-injected session digest and per-prompt recall injection, drift-pinned knowledge nodes, per-turn capture, an optional server-side auto-curation cron (drains the capture journal into memory nodes on a schedule so cloud sessions curate automatically), and a self-verifying harness. Reachable from the terminal and cloud sessions. Bundles a structural layer for mechanical impact analysis: a compiled Salesforce metadata dependency graph for Salesforce projects, and graphify (a local tree-sitter code graph covering Swift, web, and generic repos) for every other project type. Includes a one-time knowledge-base backfill plus ongoing-freshness hooks for onboarding onto existing codebases (any project type). An install skill sets it up per project from bundled reference implementations (a project-type question picks the profile); a second skill, remember, is a wrap-up command that dispatches the curators, both of them, so the often-forgotten knowledge-curator actually runs, to save a finished work item into the project's second brain.

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Two parallel-session-safe git sync skills. pull-latest brings a checkout up to date with its remote without rewriting or discarding history (fetch, fast-forward, or merge pull; never rebase, reset, or push). reset-to-remote hard-resets a repo to exactly mirror its remote, the safe alternative to deleting and re-cloning. Both assume other agent sessions may share the repo and stop rather than clobber in-flight work.
